---
title: "Scrollable Combo Box"
format: html
---

`wt::widget::configureScrollableComboPopup()` configures a `QComboBox` so its dropdown is height-limited and scrollable.

## Problem

On Gtk+/Linux, non-editable `QComboBox` widgets use a native menu popup that ignores `maxVisibleItems`. With hundreds of data keys, the menu can extend beyond the screen.

## Solution

Call `configureScrollableComboPopup(combo)` after creating the combo. This:

1. Sets `combobox-popup: 0` so Qt uses an internal `QListView` popup.
2. Sets `maxVisibleItems` (default 15).
3. Ensures the list view shows a vertical scrollbar when needed.

## Usage

```cpp
#include "Common/ScrollableComboBox.hpp"

auto * combo = new QComboBox();
wt::widget::configureScrollableComboPopup(combo);
```

ScatterPlot axis and feature-key combos use this utility in `ScatterPlotPropertiesWidget`.
